accepted_answers.name: RapidFuzz
accepted_answers.why: MIT-licensed, C++-backed successor to fuzzywuzzy/thefuzz: same scores, far faster, more metrics, actively maintained.

accepted_answers.name: difflib (Python standard library)
accepted_answers.why: Accepted for trivial stdlib-only similarity needs (SequenceMatcher, get_close_matches).

notes: Strong consensus for non-trivial matching: RapidFuzz over fuzzywuzzy (fuzzywuzzy went GPL, is unmaintained). difflib suffices only for simple cases.
problem: Implementing fuzzy string matching in Python with hand-coded edit-distance loops.
